 Order

This petition is filed for quashing of FIR No.512/2021 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Adarsh Nagar on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement vide settlement dated 7th January, 2023 which is on record of this Court.
2.
Petitioner nos. 1 to 3 and respondent No.2-complainat are present in the Court while petitioner No. 4 is present though VC.
All of them have been duly identified by the Investigating Officer and their counsel.

3. As per settlement, a balance sum of Rs.7 lacs has been tendered to the respondent No.2 by way of DD No.306686 dated 3rd April, 2023 drawn on Yes Bank in the Court today which is duly received and acknowledged by her.
Respondent no.2-complainant states that all the aspects of settlement have been taken care of and no further amounts are to be received, and she has no objection to quashing of the FIR.
4. Marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 was solemnized on 25th February, 2020 but due to differences, it stood dissolved vide decree of divorce dated 10th April, 2023.
No child was born out of this wedlock.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.512/2021 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Adarsh Nagar
and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
